description: §6.7.7 `deps=[]` is fetch-on-mount-only (RUNTIME, sqlEngine:"real"). The body reads @userId, but the explicit empty list suppresses inference: setting @userId to 2 does NOT re-fetch, so @userData stays user 1 ("a"). Pre-S444 an empty list was indistinguishable from an absent attribute and the body re-fetched on the inferred @userId.
rationale: §6.7.7: "When present, `deps` overrides inference." + the SPEC example `<request id="config" deps=[]>` annotated "Fetch on mount only — no reactive deps" (also Worked Example 2).
